label: Non-INFINITE_1 intellects have non-maximal power, from non-maximal act bounding knowing
meaning: Let x have intellect and not be INFINITE_1. Its degree of act is not maximal (first premise) and bounds every degree at which it knows anything (second premise), so it is a non-maximal bound of x's power of knowing. Intellect is not used. Conditional consequence; both premises stay open.
